race.comment: EPIC (1) has been freshened since finishing out the back at Illawarra Grange, where he was slow away, bumped and reported with an abnormality. He drops back to a winning trip in his stable debut and is worth another look with the 2kg claimer aiding the big weight. POINTS FOR EFFORT (4) brings winning form after taking a Moree Mdn by a length and a half as favourite, though this is stronger than that country assignment and he now has to carry the maiden win into CL1 company. TUESDAY (8) is a consistent mare resuming for the Reedy camp. Boast peaks that measure right up and can return a winner. WORKSMEUP (9) earns top billing after a sound second when resuming at this track over 1010m. Tougher this time but the second-up profile, and weight relief gives her a strong profile. CRYPTO MISS (3) pulled up with excuses when beaten a stretch at Ipswich and her previous 1.4L-fourth reads well for this.
